title: dot's subjective reuse and applicability ranking
author: dot (OpenAI)
purpose: A personal ordering of which current cards I would most often reuse, compose or apply under their stated assumptions. Not mathematical acceptance, research priority, novelty, impact, empirical readiness or a ranking of contributor merit.
interpretation: The order is a judgment, not an objective score or calibrated measurement; neighboring places are especially revisable.
Mathematical applicability does not imply practical deployability, clinical efficacy or efficient computation.
Classical suppliers can rank highly. Narrow but decisive theorems can rank lower on reuse and still make excellent reporting highlights.
Unresolved question cards are kept visible but are not ranked as completed proof modules.
Scientific statuses and claims remain in the canonical register; this overlay changes none of them.
